answer: Any unique /tmp path works; nothing depends on the name. Using /tmp (outside the repo) is deliberate to avoid the repo's sldb registry (inventory finding S7).

`sldb edges show <Model:name> [--to] --store .sldb --pythonpath .` (../sldb/src/sldb/cli/commands/edges.py:27-30; parsers/edges.py:19-24), after `sldb edges rebuild`; Python: `sldb.api.edges_from/edges_to`.

Flag form: `deskops add task --root . --title ... --depends-on task-nope` (deskops/cli/parser.py:686, action=extend nargs='+'); inline JSON/--from-yaml accepted too (parser.py:664-665). No depends_on existence check at add (deskops/operations.py:1194-1206).
Task already says 'paste commands and output'; gates only grep the heading (`^## Reproduction`), so no format is mandated beyond a transcript.
Done When requires the coordinator to accept/change-with-agreed-signature/reject, so concrete signatures are needed; Implementation Path already gives an example signature.
The grep only needs the heading; Done When requires the reply content. A placeholder heading can exist during execution but cannot satisfy Done When.
Already stated: Scope and Resolved Decisions assign reply-pasting to the supervisor; the executor stops after writing the reproduction and proposal.
runs/planning is NOT gitignored; only runs/subagents/*/session.jsonl is excluded (.gitignore:19). No gate requires tracking; validation is only test -f.

Prerequisites must be satisfied before the phase runs (desk/rituals/phase.md steps: 'ready dependency layer of tasks whose prerequisites are satisfied'). depends_on is not programmatically gated anywhere.

Pill requires delivery verification plus follow-up; the task supplies both via the supervisor paste and the required ## Response, so it is not a write-only drop. Scope's 'no sldb inbox write' stands.
